## Base model (PADP): Actual INV policy, Max age 8, Discard 9, sell occur for age 0-4
# Start measuring the analysis time of the model
```{r}
A <- 8

start.time <- Sys.time()

Pbase <- MIPModel() %>%
  # Decision Variables
  add_variable(p[i, j, a], i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 0, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>%  # 21, Production
  add_variable(f[i, j, a], i = 1:I, j = 0:t, a = 0:A, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>%  # 21, Inventory at the factory WH
  add_variable(r[i, j, a], i = 1:I, j = 0:t, a = 0:A, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>%  # 21, Inventory at the rented WH
  add_variable(sf[i, j, a], i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 0:A, type ="continuous", lb = 0) %>%  # 21, Sales from the factory WH
  add_variable(sr[i, j, a], i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 0:A, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>%  # 21, Sales from the rented WH
  add_variable(q[i, j, a], i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 0:A, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>% # 21, Transfer to the rented WH
  add_variable(bvf[i, j, a], i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 0:A, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>% # 21, Bonus volume for every order dispatched from FWH
  add_variable(bvr[i, j, a], i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 0:A, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>% # 21, Bonus volume up for every order dispatched from RWH 
  
  add_variable(x[j], j = 1:t, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>%  # 22, extra raw milk
  
  add_variable(da[i, j], i = 1:I, j = 1:t, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>% # 21, total discarded product reaching the maximum age
  add_variable(df[i, j], i = 1:I, j = 1:t, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>% # 21, discarded product reaching the maximum age from the FWH
  add_variable(dr[i, j], i = 1:I, j = 1:t, type = "continuous", lb = 0) %>% # 21, total discarded product reaching the maximum age fro the RWH
  # Binary variables for if-then conditions
  add_variable(e[j], j = 1:t, type = "binary", lb = 0) %>%  # 22, 1 = need extra raw milk, 0 = otherwise (contract milk is sufficient)
     
  # Constraints
  # Milk supply constraint
  add_constraint(sum_expr(p[i, j, 0], i=1:I) >= N[j], j=1:t) %>% # 2
 
  #Extra milk required constraint
  add_constraint(sum_expr(p[i, j, 0], i=1:I) <= N[j] + x[j], j=1:t) %>% # 3
  add_constraint(sum_expr(p[i, j, 0], i=1:I) - N[j] <= M1 * e[j], j=1:t) %>% # 4
  add_constraint(N[j] - sum_expr(p[i, j, 0], i=1:I) <= M1 * (1 - e[j]), j=1:t) %>% # 5
  
  # Production capacity constraint
  add_constraint(sum_expr(p[i, j, 0], i = 1:I) <= G * G_cap * V[j] * H, j=1:t) %>% # 6

  # Inventory balance constraints
  # AT factory WH
  add_constraint(f[i, 0, 0] == IF0[i], i = 1:I) %>%  # 7, t=0 inventory age 0 at the factory WH
  add_constraint(f[i, 0, a] == 0, i = 1:I, a = 1:A) %>%  # 8, t=0 inventory age 1,2 at the factory WH
  add_constraint(f[i, j, 0] == p[i, j, 0] - sf[i, j, 0] - q[i, j, 0] - bvf[i, j, 0], i = 1:I , j = 1:t) %>% # 9, inventory balance age 0 month product at the factory WH
  add_constraint(f[i, j, a] == f[i, j-1, a-1] - sf[i, j, a] - q[i, j, a] - bvf[i, j, a], i = 1:I , j = 1:t, a = 1:A) %>% # 10, inventory balance age >0 month product at the factory WH
  
  # At rented WH
  add_constraint(r[i, 0, a] == 0, i = 1:I, a = 0:A) %>% # 11, t=0 no inventory age 0,1,2 at the rented WH
  add_constraint(r[i, j, 0] == q[i, j, 0] - sr[i, j, 0] - bvr[i, j, 0], i = 1:I, j = 1:t) %>% # 12, inventory balance age 0 month product at the rented WH
  add_constraint(r[i, j, a] == r[i, j - 1, a-1] - sr[i, j, a] + q[i, j, a] - bvr[i, j, a], i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 1:A) %>% # 13, inventory balance age >0 month product at the rented WH

  # 99% service level, Safety stock level constraint
  add_constraint(sum_expr(f[i, j, a], a = 0:1) >= Z * SD[i] * sqrLt[i], i = 1:I, j = 1:t) %>% # 14
  
  # Factory warehouse capacity constraint
  add_constraint(sum_expr(f[i, j, a], i = 1:I, a = 0:A) <= F_cap[j], j=1:t) %>% #15

  # Sales and demand constraint
  add_constraint(sum_expr(sf[i, j, a], a = 0:A) + sum_expr(sr[i, j, a], a = 0:A) == D[i, j], i = 1:I, j = 1:t) %>% #16
  # Bonus volumes constraint
  add_constraint(sum_expr(bvf[i, j, a] + bvr[i, j, a], a = 0:A) == BV[i, j], i = 1:I , j = 1:t) %>% #17, use actual bonus volume instead of D*B
  
  # Products with age >9 are discarded
  add_constraint(df[i, j] == f[i, j-1, a], i = 1:I , j = 1:t, a = A) %>% # 18
  add_constraint(dr[i, j] == r[i, j-1, a], i = 1:I , j = 1:t, a = A) %>% # 19
  add_constraint(da[i, j] == df[i, j] + dr[i, j], i = 1:I , j = 1:t) %>% # 20
     
  # Objective Function # 1
  set_objective(
    (sum_expr(sf[i, j, a] * SP[i] * SP1, i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 0:1)) +
    (sum_expr(sr[i, j, a] * SP[i] * SP1, i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 0:1)) +
    (sum_expr(sf[i, j, a] * SP[i] * SP2, i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 2)) +
    (sum_expr(sr[i, j, a] * SP[i] * SP2, i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 2)) +
    (sum_expr(sf[i, j, a] * SP[i] * SP3, i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 3)) +
    (sum_expr(sr[i, j, a] * SP[i] * SP3, i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 3)) +
    (sum_expr(sf[i, j, a] * SP[i] * SP4, i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 4)) +
    (sum_expr(sr[i, j, a] * SP[i] * SP4, i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 4)) -
  (
    sum_expr(CP[i] * p[i, j, 0], i = 1:I, j = 1:t) +  # Process cost
    (CN * (sum_expr(p[i, j, 0], i = 1:I, j = 1:t) - sum_expr(x[j], j = 1:t))) + # Contract milk cost
    sum_expr(CX * x[j], j = 1:t) +  # Extra milk cost
    sum_expr(CF * f[i, j, a], i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 0:A) +  # Holding cost at the factory
    sum_expr(CR * r[i, j, a], i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 0:A) +  # Holding cost at the rented WH
    sum_expr(CT * q[i, j, a], i = 1:I, j = 1:t, a = 0:A) +  # Transfer cost
    sum_expr(CO * da[i, j], i = 1:I, j = 1:t)  
    ),
    "max"
  )

# Solve the model
resultPbase <- solve_model(Pbase, with_ROI(solver = "gurobi", verbose = TRUE))

# End measuring the analysis time of the model
end.time <- Sys.time()
duration <- as.duration(end.time - start.time)
period <- as.period(duration)
period

```

sprintf(CN_Pbase, fmt = '%#.2f')

MG_Pbase
